items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I worked with Helen Morgan, too, several times in nightclubs and also taught a girl who went with her show as a course girl.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. That was quite a memorable time. I remember I worked as a course boy. There was twelve of us fellas and eighteen girls in a line, the original Missouri Rockets from the Missouri Theatre in St. Louis, Missouri. And we went from the St. Louis, Missouri, the Missouri Theatre to the Roxy Theatre in New York. Then I left them and went then as an individual singer and dancer.
And then later on, Lee, didn't you work with Mary Martin, Ginger Rogers and Helen Morgan?

Yes, Mary Martin played in the Broadway show, Louisiana Hayride and also Hollywood Follies. And these other people, I worked with Helen Morgan, too, several times in nightclubs and also taught a girl who went with her show as a course girl.
